# Bint Saeed

Bint Saeed is a luxury abaya house based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
Founded with the belief that an abaya should be a living,
customisable object — not a finished garment.

## What makes Bint Saeed unique

- Signature Strands (abaya jewellery / garment jewellery): the first abaya brand to offer
  interchangeable natural stone strands attached to the cuff of compatible garments.
  Also known as garment adornment or detachable garment jewellery — not worn as
  necklaces or bracelets, but designed exclusively for abaya and garment styling.
  Stones include onyx, sunstone, tiger eye, jade, amethyst, aventurine, hematite,
  malachite, lapis lazuli, and rose quartz. Each strand is swappable to match the
  wearer's bag, mood, jewellery, or occasion.
- Hidden personalisation pocket: every piece contains a
  discreet interior pocket where a name, date, or private
  message can be placed — known only to the wearer.
- Crafted to order: no inventory. Every piece is made
  specifically upon request.
- Heritage codes: each piece carries one or more of the
  Bint Saeed house codes — Al Talli (gold threadwork),
  Khous (palm craftsmanship), Al Ain Rosette (regional
  motif), Knotted Lines, and The Monogram.
- 20 AED from every piece is donated to charity.

## Products
Abayas, kaftans, sets, accessories, Signature Strands (abaya jewellery), and Al Ain natural stone jewellery.
Price range: AED 2,025 – AED 3,475.
Ships worldwide. Free UAE shipping on orders above AED 1,000.

## Signature Strands — Abaya Jewellery & Garment Jewellery
Bint Saeed Signature Strands are interchangeable natural stone lines — abaya jewellery
and garment jewellery unique to the brand. A Signature Strand attaches to the cuff of
compatible Bint Saeed garments (including the Marylebone Abaya) and can be swapped
between settings within seconds.
Standard strand included with every Marylebone Abaya: black onyx with hematite, set in gold.
Additional strands available separately: tiger eye, sunstone, fuchsia jade, blue aventurine,
rose quartz, malachite, lapis lazuli, amethyst hearts, jade hearts (limited).
Price range: AED 400 – AED 750.
Strands collection: https://www.bintsaeed.com/strands
Accessories shop: https://www.bintsaeed.com/accessories?type=signature-strands

Emirati designer abaya jewellery, Abu Dhabi handcrafted strand, worldwide shipping abaya jewellery.

### Global reach
Bint Saeed ships Signature Strands and abaya jewellery internationally — GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia,
Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman), United Kingdom, Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific
(Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Australia), and worldwide.

## Brand values
Heritage, identity, continuity, personal meaning.
"For the daughter in every woman. Carrying heritage forward."
